notes.title: 📢 SCHiM Out Now! 👀🎉
notes.content:
SCHiM is OUT NOW!
You can play SCHiM on PC, Mac, Linux and SteamDeck.

We are super happy to share SCHiM with you all. After more than 4 years of development we can finally share it with the world! We want to thank everyone for their support and wish you all a great adventure in the shadows!

Check out our latest launch trailer:
[previewyoutube=4p8ZWSSAhXY;full][/previewyoutube]
Save 10% now with the launch discount 🏷️

About the game
SCHiM is a charming indie game about helping a lost shadow find its way back to its human by hopping around in the shadows. As you look for clever ways to move around in the world, you uncover small stories and charming details hidden in the environment.

Key features

A story of a person losing their shadow - A schim is the soul and spirit of an object or living being. Everything in the world has one, and it should never be separated! You need to find your way back to the human you belong to, before it's too late!
Unique 3D platforming - You can only move in the shadows, so you'll need to find clever ways to leap into the shadows of animated objects and moving beings to use them as your pathways.
A beautiful abstract world - The color palette changes in each level to capture the setting, time of day and mood of every location you explore.
Each level has a story to tell - Each new level has its own living scenery with small stories to uncover, inspired by real Dutch/European cities and rural locations.
Hidden in the shadows - There are lots of hidden items to discover in SCHiM, and when you find them, you help other schim restore the connection to their thing.


Thank you all for your support over the years! 🙌
Enjoy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39594768/75f91a2d3a875c9abe2565a2b918ddfcb936088c.png
Demo still available.

notes.title: SCHiM - Physical Editions Announcement | Pre-Order Now!
notes.content:
We are super excited to share our collaboration with iam8bit!

We have worked together to create two physical versions of SCHiM which can be Pre-ordered here: 
[url=]https://schim.iam8bit.com/

Standard edition:
The standard physical edition, which will be available at major retailers Americas and EMEA, features the main game alongside four bonus art cards showcasing scenes from the game, and includes cover art by Janna van Abbema. This snazzy edition will start shipping and land on store shelves on October 25. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39594768/b3dfef22e26328ebf8b0f9b3d6da015fb180397d.jpg

The Exclusive edition:
Fans may also opt for the iam8bit Exclusive Edition, which includes an 11"x17" Street Scene Poster with four Character & Shadow Sticker Sheets, as well as Exclusive Cover Art by Owen D. Pomery, all for $39.99.  This version is exclusive to iam8bit.com and will begin shipping in Q4 2024. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39594768/74c8c61c34c6728d3a6b3c3f58d8344011386d8a.jpg

The retail edition is available on PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch for $34.99, or hunt for the iam8bit Exclusive Edition, available for PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch for $39.99.

Pre-order the standard or exclusive physical edition here: 
[url=]https://schim.iam8bit.com/

Check out the physical announcement trailer:
[previewyoutube=aFZ8jocx9U4;full][/previewyoutube]
Shipping begins October 25th

The digital version of SCHiM will also be available for download beginning July 18 for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, Xbox and PC. 
Digital price: $24,99 (regional prices will vary)

There was quite a good selection of finalists. We ended up having 7 options that we thought were interesting to test in-game.

Honorable Mentions
First of all, we would like to do a couple of honorable mentions:

Category number 1: Definitely not a fit for SCHiM but it sure looks interesting.

notes.title: Create your own color palette for SCHiM!
notes.content:
Make your own color palette!
Have you had the urge to design your own color palette for a SCHiM level after seeing footage of the game? Well, we have good news! You can now mix and match the colors you would want to see in the game.
Each level in SCHiM only has 4 colors. On the website https://schim.art/ you can select 4 colors and see how it would look in-game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39594768/fe7b600604932cabd0553cfe2cdc5290299c5b5f.png

Join the contest
With this contest, we invite you to make your own color palette and share it here on steam.
The contest will run for 1 week.
The deadline for the contest will be June 27th.
Ewoud and Nils will judge the contest entries and will choose the best color palette.
The winning color palette will be used in a future level in SCHiM!

On https://schim.art/ you can save your color palette by pressing the photo camera icon in the top left corner of the page.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39594768/415d587d2935eac0bf41fa103f5ccbdbb3c21cef.png

Post it here to share your favorites and yours might end up in the game!
